allow: PowerShell($ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $url = "https://sbp.enterprisedb.com/getfile.jsp?fileid=1260148"; $dest = "$env:TEMP\\pgsql.zip"; Write-Output "Downloading to: $dest"; $start = Get-Date; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -UseBasicParsing; $elapsed = \(Get-Date\) - $start; $size = \(Get-Item $dest\).Length / 1MB; Write-Output \("Downloaded {0:N2} MB in {1:N1}s" -f $size, $elapsed.TotalSeconds\))

PowerShell($dest = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs"; if \(-not \(Test-Path $dest\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force | Out-Null }; if \(Test-Path "$dest\\pgsql"\) { Write-Output "Removing existing $dest\\pgsql"; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$dest\\pgsql" }; Write-Output "Extracting to: $dest"; $start = Get-Date; Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\\pgsql.zip" -DestinationPath $dest -Force; $elapsed = \(Get-Date\) - $start; Write-Output \("Extracted in {0:N1}s" -f $elapsed.TotalSeconds\); Write-Output "---"; Get-ChildItem "$dest\\pgsql" | Select-Object Name, Mode)
